cases.input_es: Serie 1D del patrón, límites ppm, Dref y Tref, secuencia y forma.
cases.input_en: Reference 1D series, ppm bounds, Dref and Tref, sequence and shape.
cases.output_es: Escala experimental de b; JSON, CSV de atenuación/residuos e informe HTML.
cases.output_en: Experimental b scale; JSON, attenuation/residual CSV and HTML report.
cases.success_es: Caso HDO compartido: pendiente 1,58627 y R² = 0,999829, reproducidos desde 23 espectros.
cases.success_en: Shared HDO case: slope 1.58627 and R² = 0.999829, reproduced from 23 spectra.
cases.limits: Shared profile was measured by calibration_tbo.py using a fixed spectral point/window diagnostic, not newly produced by the helper integral pathway. Do not attribute identical slope to integral software. Thermal reference is approximate. TopSpin 3.6.4 live execution pending.

cases.input_es: FID/Bruker, región ppm elegida para la muestra, metadatos, perfil TBO y TTMS.
cases.input_en: FID/Bruker, sample-specific ppm region, metadata, TBO profile and TTMS.
cases.output_es: Atenuaciones, D, distribuciones TRAIn, residuos y factores por bloque.
cases.output_en: Attenuations, D, TRAIn distributions, residuals and per-block factors.
cases.success_es: Caso KK2 archivado: 230 espectros, 10 rampas. KK2-50/51: tres bloques cada una; trazabilidad del procesamiento.
cases.success_en: Archived KK2 case: 230 spectra, 10 ramps. KK2-50/51: three blocks each; processing provenance.
cases.primary_D_summary: KK2-50 0.143339 ± 0.008256; KK2-51 0.088614 ± 0.006584 ×10^-9 m²/s; mean and sample SD across three blocks, not confidence interval.
cases.limits: ARCHIVED outputs: current v7 audit identifies changed procs files. Do not claim full current reproduction or unchanged processing parameters. TTMS + temperature is the principal scenario, factors stored separately. KK2-52 exploratory, not a success headline. Linear-polymer mass calibrations do not establish absolute masses of stars/brushes; omit mass claims.

cases.entry: Select a fixed ppm region → attenuation/distribution → fit/invert → save result
cases.input_es: TP194, 4,4182 ± 0,04 ppm, los 23 puntos válidos; calibración guardada.
cases.input_en: TP194, 4.4182 ± 0.04 ppm, all 23 valid points; stored calibration.
cases.output_es: D antes/después, incertidumbre condicional, distribución y residuos.
cases.output_en: D before/after, conditional uncertainty, distribution and residuals.
cases.screenshot_metrics: D measured 0.3723534; D final 0.3266501 ±0.00249 ×10^-9 m²/s (conditional OLS); R² .998781039; no points excluded. fRef .8772583, fT=1.
cases.limits: These values are visible in real screenshot; snapshot is not a new fit. Conditional OLS error excludes calibration/reference/temperature/model uncertainty. TTMS identity and viscosity are conditional, not confirmed molecular identification.

cases.entry: Local signal · TRAIn / compare; match extraction, grid, method and corrections
cases.input_es: TP194 cerca de 7,736 ppm; misma extracción y rejilla de 2048 bins en los dos caminos.
cases.input_en: TP194 near 7.736 ppm; identical extraction and 2048-bin grid in both pathways.
cases.output_es: Comparación señal local / bin DOSY: pico, media, forma y residuos.
cases.output_en: Local signal / DOSY-bin comparison: peak, mean, shape and residuals.
cases.success_es: Tres rampas reales: diferencias de forma normalizadas = 0 en estas ejecuciones; D pico y media idénticas.
cases.success_en: Three real ramps: normalized shape differences = 0 in these runs; identical D peak and mean.
cases.limits: Operational reproducibility on these data, not independent scientific validation, species count or universal parity across different grids. Resin screenshot uses 256 bins and different values.

cases.entry: DOSY map → decomposition of active projection → inspect unassigned signal → export data
cases.success_es: En TP194 se evita una banda compensadora sin máximo propio y se conservan ~6 % sin asignar visibles.
cases.success_en: In TP194 an unsupported compensating band is avoided and ~6% remains visibly unassigned.
cases.limits: Two supported bands are descriptive, not two demonstrated chemical species. Archived map/inversion retained. Gaussian projection residual is not raw attenuation residual.
